options.content:
Every minute, each query is evaluated over the last 5 minutes. A rule turns the query results into a pass or fail per check, then decides rollback or promote per rollout. Exact and approx decide separately from their own results.

| rule | queries | a check fails when | a rollout rolls back when, else promotes |
|---|---|---|---|
| ours | p99_canary, p99_stable | canary p99 / stable p99 > 1.1 | 3 failed checks in a row out of 10 |
| flagger | p99_canary, success_rate_canary | canary p99 > 0.5 s or canary success rate < 99% | 10 failed checks in total; promotes after 25 passed checks (up to 34 checks) |
| argo_rollouts | success_rate_canary | canary success rate < 95% (a check every 5 evaluations) | more than 3 failed checks out of 10 |
| cloudwatch | p99_canary | canary p99 > 0.5 s | 4 of the last 5 checks failed, within 10 checks |
| keptn | p95_canary | canary p95 > 1.1 × the mean of the last 3 passing checks, or ≥ 0.6 s (a check every 10 evaluations) | the check fails; each check is its own evaluation |

panels.description: The top two rows of marks are the rule's checks and decisions: the upper row is exact, the lower row approx. Small orange: a failed check. Large red: rollback. Large green: promote. Hover a time to see every query value and mark at that time.
